name: Evil Tuner XXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Internet radio (30,000+ stations), or a phone over Wi-Fi or AirPlay, played into an MPC track through a granular engine, filter, character stages, delay, reverb, trance gate, stutter, tempo-synced looper and three LFOs. Inspired by the Endorphin.es Evil Pet (no affiliation, no code). Needs a network.
